Exact temporary qualification script:
from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,os
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspaces/repository/tests')
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspaces/repository/executor')
os.chdir('/workspaces/repository')
import torch,transformers
from resident_qwen import oracle_cases
from qwen_graph import load_model
print('Engineering qualification only: ordinary HF host calls, no TCP/dispatcher/serving-speed claim.',flush=True)
print('torch',torch.__version__,'transformers',transformers.__version__,flush=True)
cases,vocab=oracle_cases(64,True)
print('independent_batch1_oracle',json.dumps(cases),flush=True)
with torch.no_grad():
    model=load_model('/workspaces/.cache/bpfusion/qwen25-05b-fp16.bin')
    for batch in (2,4,8):
        groups=[(str(i),[i]*batch) for i in range(len(cases))]
        # Same prefix length, different real prompts, independent KV lanes.
        assert len(cases[0][0])==len(cases[2][0])
        groups.append(('mixed5',[0,2]*(batch//2)))
        for name,indices in groups:
            inputs=torch.tensor([cases[i][0] for i in indices],device='cuda')
            output=model(inputs,use_cache=True,logits_to_keep=1)
            past=output.past_key_values
            token=output.logits[:,-1,:].argmax(-1)
            selected=[token]
            for step in range(63):
                output=model(token[:,None],past_key_values=past,use_cache=True,logits_to_keep=1)
                past=output.past_key_values
                token=output.logits[:,-1,:].argmax(-1);selected.append(token)
            actual=torch.stack(selected,dim=1).cpu().tolist()
            mismatches=[]
            for lane,case in enumerate(indices):
                expected=cases[case][1]
                if actual[lane]!=expected:
                    k=next(j for j,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(actual[lane],expected)) if a!=b)
                    mismatches.append({'lane':lane,'case':case,'first_index':k,'actual':actual[lane][k],'expected':expected[k]})
            print(json.dumps({'batch':batch,'group':name,'cases':indices,'actual':actual,'pass':not mismatches,'mismatches':mismatches}),flush=True)
print('BATCH_SHAPE_MATRIX_COMPLETE',flush=True)
